digest.component_or_area: bridge runner and repair pause coordination
propositions: Bridge execution must be portable across local shells, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI, and bare environments through a single runner-neutral entrypoint without breaking legacy reconcile vocabulary or checked-out workflows
Destructive-repair schedule safety must be owned by a provider-neutral durable gate lifecycle using git refs and CAS coordination with no GitHub CLI dependency
Legacy reconcile callers must retain their published defaults, exit behavior, and mutation boundaries while new noun-based bridge routes are added
Local and all CI provider bridge execution must use the packaged Python core entrypoint rebar bridge run with no repository-local runner script required
Repair pause ownership must read existing pause snapshot, call set_pause, and clear only its observed OID through release with a per-invocation repair token
GitHub Actions workflows must preserve RECONCILE_CONTINUOUS re-dispatch and 20-minute scheduling while Jenkins and GitLab use native provider scheduling
